name: Table
description: An editable table (line items, attendees, measurements) with typed columns: text, number, currency, date, choice and tick box. Per-cell validation, totals, and spreadsheet-style keyboard editing.

props.name: columns
props.label: Columns
props.description: A list of columns: { "key", "label", "type": text | number | currency | date | select | checkbox, "required", "options" (select), "min" / "max" (number, currency), "width" (px) }.

props.name: show_totals
props.label: Show totals
props.description: A footer row summing the number and currency columns.

props.name: currency
props.label: Currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for currency columns (USD, EUR, NZD, …).

props.name: default_rows
props.label: Starting rows
props.description: Rows shown before the person edits (a list of objects keyed by column key). Not stored until the table is edited.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab into the table (one stop). Arrow keys move between cells, Home / End to the row's ends (Ctrl+Home / End to the table's), Enter, F2 or typing edits a cell; Enter saves and moves down, Shift+Enter up, Escape cancels; Tab / Shift+Tab move cell by cell and leave the table at its ends. Delete clears a cell, Space or Enter toggles a tick box, Ctrl+Enter adds a row; each row's Delete row button is the last cell of the row.
